newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria Air repairs Boeing 737, leases freighter.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria Air repairs Boeing 737, leases freighter.

text.p: Nigeria's struggling state airline has repaired a Boeing 737 aircraft and leased a Boeing 707 freighter, taking its operational fleet to four planes, the national news agency said on Monday.
The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) said the Nigeria Airways 737 had been grounded for over two years. Its two engines were recently repaired in Israel.
It said the Ghanaian-registered 707 was leased from Jason Air and would operate on routes connecting Lagos and Ostend, Belgium, the Middle East and other African destinations.
Nigeria Airways suffers from heavy debts and an ageing fleet. In recent years it has had difficulty keeping to schedules on routes within Africa and outside the continent.
